questions.question: What does it mean to install software?
options: To put a software program onto a computer so it can be used
To turn off the computer completely
To print a document on paper
To remove every file from the computer
questions.explanation: Installing software means putting a program onto a computer so it can be used.

questions.question: Which item helps a user install a software program?
options: An installer
A recycle bin
A speaker
A wallpaper
questions.explanation: An installer is a program or file used to guide the installation of software.

questions.question: What is an executable file mainly used for?
options: Running a program or starting a software process
Cleaning the computer screen
Printing a picture
Changing the computer's physical keyboard
questions.explanation: An executable file contains instructions that the computer can run to start a program or process.

questions.question: Why should you choose a trusted source when downloading software?
options: To reduce the chance of downloading harmful or unwanted software
To make the monitor brighter
To make the keyboard louder
To make every program free
questions.explanation: Trusted sources help reduce the risk of downloading software that may harm the computer or contain unwanted programs.

questions.question: Which of these is an example of malware?
options: A virus
A printer
A monitor
A keyboard
questions.explanation: A virus is a type of malware. Malware is software designed to harm a computer or gain unauthorized access to information.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of antivirus software?
options: To help prevent and remove malware
To increase the size of the monitor
To create paper documents
To replace the computer's keyboard
questions.explanation: Antivirus software helps protect the computer by detecting, preventing, and removing malware.

questions.question: You download a program from an unfamiliar website. What is the safest action before installing it?
options: Check that the source is trusted and that the download is safe
Install it immediately because every download is safe
Turn off all protection before opening it
Share the file with everyone first
questions.explanation: Checking the source before installing helps reduce the risk of malware or unwanted software.

questions.question: During installation, a program asks where it should be installed. What is this part of the process mainly about?
options: Choosing installation settings or location
Turning the computer into a printer
Deleting the operating system
Changing the monitor into a speaker
questions.explanation: Installation may ask you to choose settings such as where the program will be installed.

questions.question: What are default settings?
options: Settings selected by the software unless the user changes them
Settings that permanently damage the computer
Settings found only on printers
Settings that automatically delete all files
questions.explanation: Default settings are the choices provided by the software unless the user changes them.

questions.question: Why is it useful to check available storage space before installing a large program?
options: The computer needs enough storage space for the software and its files
Storage space controls the computer's screen color
A program can only be installed when the keyboard is unplugged
Storage space is needed only for printing
questions.explanation: Software and its related files need storage space, so checking available space can prevent installation problems.

questions.question: Which statement best describes uninstalling software?
options: Removing a software program from the computer
Installing the same program twice
Copying a program to a printer
Opening a program for the first time
questions.explanation: Uninstalling removes a software program from the computer.

questions.question: A software package is compressed into an archive. What may need to happen before some files can be used?
options: The files may need to be decompressed or extracted
The monitor must be replaced
The keyboard must be removed
The computer must be painted
questions.explanation: Compressed files may need to be decompressed or extracted before their contents can be used.

questions.question: A learner wants to install a free game. The website suddenly asks the learner to disable antivirus protection. What is the safest response?
options: Stop and check the source and safety of the software before continuing
Disable antivirus immediately because the website requested it
Give the website personal information first
Install several unknown programs at the same time
questions.explanation: A request to disable protection is a reason to pause and verify the source and safety of the software.

questions.question: Which sequence best represents a careful software-installation process?
options: Choose a trusted source → download the installer → review settings → install
Install first → find the software source later → check safety last
Turn off protection → download anything → install everything
Delete important files → install → check the source
questions.explanation: A careful process begins with a trusted source, then uses the installer and reviews important settings before installation.

questions.question: Why should a user pay attention to installation options instead of clicking through every screen automatically?
options: Some options affect what is installed and how the software is configured
Every installation screen changes the computer's hardware
Installation options are only for changing the wallpaper
Clicking every button always makes software safer
questions.explanation: Installation options can affect what is installed and how the program is configured, so users should review them.

questions.question: A program is no longer needed. What is the appropriate action if you want to remove the program?
options: Use the computer's normal software-uninstall process
Delete random system files
Turn off the monitor and leave the program installed
Rename every file in the program folder
questions.explanation: Using the normal uninstall process is the appropriate way to remove a software program.

questions.question: Software can sometimes be installed from physical media such as a CD or DVD. What should still be considered?
options: The source and safety of the software should still be checked
Physical media can never contain harmful software
Antivirus protection is never needed for physical media
Every CD or DVD is automatically trusted
questions.explanation: The lesson emphasizes safe software practices; the fact that software is on physical media does not by itself prove that it is safe.

questions.question: What is one reason antivirus software may be useful even after software has been installed?
options: It can help detect or remove malware
It makes every program run without using storage
It changes a laptop into a printer
It guarantees that every website is safe
questions.explanation: Antivirus software can help detect and remove malware, including harmful software that may already be present.

questions.question: A learner has little free storage space and wants to install a large program. Which choice shows good planning?
options: Check storage requirements and available space before installing
Install it without checking because storage does not matter
Delete important personal files immediately
Disable the computer's security tools first
questions.explanation: Checking the program's storage needs and the available space helps the learner decide whether installation can proceed safely.

questions.question: Which habit best summarizes safe software installation?
options: Use trusted sources, check safety, review settings, and protect the computer
Download from any site and install without reading
Disable security tools whenever a program requests it
Install software without checking storage or source
questions.explanation: Safe installation combines trusted sources, safety checks, attention to settings, and computer protection.
